fields.label: Name
fields.description: Your name for this connection, for example "OpenAI" or "Ollama on the office server". Must be unique.
The web address of the service's API, for example https://api.openai.com/v1.
fields.label: Address
API Key
fields.description: The secret key from your AI provider. Required before you can switch this on, unless the address is on your own network.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Switch off to stop Crema using this service, without deleting the connection.
How long to wait for an answer before giving up. Raise this for a service running on your own hardware, which can be slow.
fields.label: Wait Up To (seconds)

fields.description: The most this service may cost per calendar month, added up across every use case that sends to it. 0 means no limit. A request that would go over is stopped before the service is called.
fields.label: Monthly Budget (USD)
